programme.title: SM-veckan
programme.desc: Damernas final i beachvattenpolo avgörs i Inre Hamn i centrala Karlstad. Kommentator: AnnaMaria Jansson. Gästexpert: Erik Rudberg.

programme.title: SM-veckan
programme.desc: I Karlstads Inre Hamn avgörs damernas final i kanotpolo. Det är en tuff och fartfylld sport, där manövrering av kanoten kombineras med bollteknik och lagspel. Kommentator: Peter Jonsson. Expert: Eva Lindmark.

programme.title: Tågresa genom antikens Grekland
programme.desc: Den antika grekiska kulturen som genomsyrade denna del av världen hade en bestående påverkan. Alice ser den spektakulära staden Efesos och besöker en gammal vän vid Pergamons akropol. Och innan hon avslutar sin odyssé sätter hon en expert om Troja på prov för att pröva äktheten av de antika berättelserna i Homeros Iliaden.

programme.title: SM-veckan
programme.desc: Under SM-veckans sista dag avgörs lag-SM i friidrott. Finalerna i beachvattenpolo och kanotpolo avgörs i Inre Hamn. Beachvolleyboll, parapingis, 3x3 basket och dragkamp står också på rogrammet. Priset till Sveriges Bästa Idrottsstad delas traditionsenligt ut i vår studio på Stora Torget i Karlstad. Programledare: Maria Wallberg.

programme.title: Egenland - Finland är fantastiskt
programme.desc: Mystiska grottor i Åbo. Inte långt utanför Åbo centrum ligger Luolavuoris grotta, en sevärdhet som är obekant även för stor del av lokalbefolkningen. Grottan som under århundradenas gång sägs ha härbärgerat såväl rövare som rymlingar är idag ett resmål för besökare som ägnar sig grottkrypning och geocaching. Programledarna Hannamari Hoikkala och Nicke Aldén guidar till oväntade turistpärlor, unika attraktioner och fascinerande personligheter runt omkring i Finland. (Finland, 2020).

programme.title: Historiska uppfinningar
programme.desc: Hur uppfanns smarttelefonen? Det skulle krävas en Hollywoodstjärna, en missad semester och en romersk belägring för att ge oss uppfinningen som definierar vår tidsålder.

programme.title: Ett enklare liv
programme.desc: I Franska Polynesien har Rick och Jasna kastat ankare. De är två rastlösa själar som lever ett till synes drömliv mitt i Stilla havet, men bristen på färskvatten och plötsliga orkanstormar gör livet på havet oförutsägbart. Del 8 av 9: Nomader på havet.

programme.title: Världens natur
programme.desc: När jorden blir varmare tvingas alla anpassa sig. Möt strutsen i Namiböknen, Sydamerikas märkliga manvarg och den asiatiska stäppens saigaantilop med dess extremt förstorade nos. Djuren, liksom den fjärdedel av jordens befolkning som bor i torra områden, påverkas av jordens hetta.

programme.title: Så gjordes Planet Earth III
programme.desc: Följ med bakom kulisserna och ta del av vilket arbete som krävs för att skapa en av världens mest spektakulära naturserier.

programme.title: Vilda västern
programme.desc: När järnvägarnas kapplöper för att ansluta östkusten med västkusten inleder ett nytt kapitel i USA:s dominans och leder till framväxten av en amerikansk ikon: cowboyen.

programme.title: På resa i Medelhavet
programme.desc: Det brittiska Gibraltar lockar fem miljoner turister varje år - varav 3 500 kommer för att gifta sig. Här möter vi de berömda berberaporna och utforskar det marina reservatet kring klippan som gett området sitt namn.

programme.title: Världens historia
programme.desc: Adolf Eichmann var arkitekten bakom den slutliga lösningen och är själva sinnebilden av den onde administratören vars händer aldrig blir blodiga. Klaus Barbie, Slaktaren från Lyon, var däremot sadisten som gärna torterade koncentrationslägerfångar själv. Både Eichmann och Barbie var två högt uppsatta nazister som lämnar Tyskland 1945 och lyckas hålla sig gömda.

programme.title: Människans bästa vän
programme.desc: I Sydney har Sarah tagit hand om fruktfladdermöss i över tio år. Hon har ett särskilt band till fladdermusen Banksi. Och i Silverton träffar vi Toto, den missförstådda emun. Toto orsakar ofta oreda i sin stad men beter sig alltid när han är med sin följeslagare Petah.

programme.title: Historiska uppfinningar
programme.desc: Hur uppfanns smarttelefonen? Det skulle krävas en Hollywoodstjärna, en missad semester och en romersk belägring för att ge oss uppfinningen som definierar vår tidsålder.

programme.title: Världens natur
programme.desc: När jorden blir varmare tvingas alla anpassa sig. Möt strutsen i Namiböknen, Sydamerikas märkliga manvarg och den asiatiska stäppens saigaantilop med dess extremt förstorade nos. Djuren, liksom den fjärdedel av jordens befolkning som bor i torra områden, påverkas av jordens hetta.

programme.title: Så gjordes Planet Earth III
programme.desc: Följ med bakom kulisserna och ta del av vilket arbete som krävs för att skapa en av världens mest spektakulära naturserier.

programme.title: På resa i Medelhavet
programme.desc: Det brittiska Gibraltar lockar fem miljoner turister varje år - varav 3 500 kommer för att gifta sig. Här möter vi de berömda berberaporna och utforskar det marina reservatet kring klippan som gett området sitt namn.

programme.title: Människans bästa vän
programme.desc: Från en gepard räddad från döden till en grupp kärleksfulla hajar avslöjar vi extraordinära vänskapsband mellan människor och djur. Som murmeldjursfamiljen som vann en motvillig trädgårdsmästares hjärta, zebran Richmond som blev medarbetare på räddningscentret, en bikupa som hjälpte en flykting att bygga upp sitt liv, och en duva som blivit en stjärna på sociala medier.

programme.title: Historien om Sverige
programme.desc: Det är goda tider för svenskarna som nu blivit kristna. Ekonomin blomstrar och skördarna är goda. Befolkningen växer och det svenska riket börjar byggas steg för steg. Men allt utmanas när tiderna plötsligt blir sämre och pesten utplånar en tredjedel av befolkningen. Simon J Berger är seriens berättare.

programme.title: Historiskt eftersnack
programme.desc: Den orättvist anklagade råttan, stegling som straffmetod och den ultimata medeltida förolämpningen. Historikerna Bo Eriksson och Annika Sandén och komikern Nisse Hallberg diskuterar pest, helgon, brott och straff. Programledare är Cecilia Düringer.

programme.title: Tågresa genom antikens Grekland
programme.desc: Den antika grekiska kulturen som genomsyrade denna del av världen hade en bestående påverkan. Alice ser den spektakulära staden Efesos och besöker en gammal vän vid Pergamons akropol. Och innan hon avslutar sin odyssé sätter hon en expert om Troja på prov för att pröva äktheten av de antika berättelserna i Homeros Iliaden.

programme.title: Antikens riken
programme.desc: I en brutal värld där naturen är både vän och fiende, har våra forntida makter precis börjat, de måste använda all sin skicklighet och uppfinningsrikedom för att forma sitt territorium och etablera sina kulturer.

programme.title: Vilda västern
programme.desc: När järnvägarnas kapplöper för att ansluta östkusten med västkusten inleder ett nytt kapitel i USA:s dominans och leder till framväxten av en amerikansk ikon: cowboyen.

programme.title: Tuhoutunut sekunneissa
programme.desc: Ron Pitts vie katsojat kulissien taakse tuhoutuneisiin kohteisiin. Tässä jaksossa myrskynmetsästäjistä tulee myrskyn uhreja, maalitehdas räjähtää ja lentokone syöksyy mereen.

programme.title: Huutokauppataisto
programme.desc: Sarjassa kierretään maailmalla huutamassa kilpaa noutamatta jääneitä matkalaukkuja, lunastamattomia tilauksia ja alkuperäisten omistajiensa unohtamia löytötavaroita. Mitä sokkona ostetuista laukuista ja paketeista paljastuu? Kuka huutokauppakonkareista onnistuu huutamaan itselleen arvokkaimman sisällön?

programme.title: Barnwood Builders
programme.desc: Mark Bowe ja hänen ammattitaitoinen käsityöläisporukkansa hyödyntävät uusiokäytössä vanhoja latoja ja mökkejä. He käyttävät puuta ja muita materiaaleja upeiden, nykyaikaisten kotien luomiseen.

After spending part of her childhood in the United States, she moved to France as a teenager where she joined her first jazz bands. An atypical artist, she performs a lot in the street while participating in festivals and creating her own albums. In 2004, she had an international success with Careless Love. Other albums have been released since, including the recent Anthem (2018), the title of which is taken from a Leonard Cohen song.

programme.title: Strauss : Une symphonie alpestre - DSO Berlin, Robin Ticciati, Reinhold Messner
programme.desc: Richard Strauss 1864 - 1949 Eine Alpensinfonie. Berlin, Tempodrom, 2021. Recorded at Berlin’s Tempodrom, the Deutsche Symphonie-Orchester Berlin and its chief conductor Robin Ticciati present Richard Strauss’s ‘An Alpine Symphony’ as a musical and philosophical mountain hike with the legendary mountaineer Reinhold Messner. The concert leads us through the Alps, lets the audience pass flowering meadows en route, through thickets and underbrush, over mountain pastures and glaciers to the summit, and finally the descent surrounded by thunderstorms. Messner provides insights into the physical and psychological borderline experiences of his mountain ascents and speaks about extreme situations, the perception of nature, and his mental state on the night before departure, during the conquest of the peak, during the long, onerous descent and the exhausted, contented return home.. Directed by Andreas Morell.

programme.title: The Noseda effect
programme.desc: The Noseda Effect is an intimate portrait of Gianandrea Noseda, filmed over three years, from his hometown of Milan, at the famous Teatro alla Scala, and continues at the Juilliard School, the Kennedy Center, the Metropolitan Opera and the Zurich Opera. The film features interviews with his family, friends and artistic collaborators, including Piotr Beczała, Renée Fleming, Stefano Poda and many others.The film includes footage of rehearsals with the Filarmonica della Scala, the Juilliard Orchestra, the National Symphony Orchestra, as well as a soundtrack from Noseda's extensive discography.

programme.title: Mozart: Symphony no. 35 - Claudio Abbado, Berliner Philharmoniker
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Mozart’s “Haffner” Symphony No. 35, K. 385, recorded during the very first Europakonzert in the Smetana Hall in Prague, 1991. Mozart originally composed the symphony as a serenade for the family of Sigmund Haffner, a childhood friend from Salzburg in 1782. The composer made some revisions in the following year, adding multiple instruments and conducted the premiere of the four-movement piece on March 23, 1783, in Vienna. The “Haffner” Symphony, as it is known now, is a transitional work in Mozart’s career. The work was meant to be party music for Salzburg and was transformed into a symphony for Vienna.

programme.desc: Vuosien aikana asiantuntijat ovat huomanneet Kanadan vesillä enemmän ja enemmän valkohaita, jopa niin pohjoisessa kuin Newfoundlandissa asti. Tutkijat selvittävät Kanadan ensimmäisen viimeiseen 150 vuoteen epäillyn haihyökkäyksen jälkeen, mikä ajaa valkohaita matkaamaan niiden pohjoisille rajoille.

programme.title: Havaijin hait
programme.desc: Alue on paratiisi yhdelle maailman väärinymmärretyimmistä olennoista eli haille. Jopa 40 lajia asuu näissä vesissä. Niissä on myös kotonaan maailmakuulu villieläinten luontokuvaaja Paul Atkins. Ohjelma johdattaa meidät Waikikin rannoilta kaukaiselle riutalle Havaijin saaristoon. Täällä hait käyttäytyvät yllättävillä tavoin, joista joitain ei nähdä muualla maailmassa.

programme.title: Tappajaeläimet
programme.desc: Ohjelmassa tutustutaan Pohjois-Amerikan kahteentoista tappavimpaan eläimeen. Mukana on eläimiä hyönteisistä nisäkkäisiin. Toiminnallinen dokumenttisarja, National Geographic.

programme.title: Hait ilmasta
programme.desc: Jos lähdet tänään rannalle, saatat kohdata suuren yllätyksen! Dronet mullistavat kaiken, mitä luulimme tietävämme haista. Ja suurin yllätys? Se, että monet hait elävät lähempänä rannikoita kuin osasimme kuvitellakaan. Nyt kannattaa vilkaista taakseen. Merten huippusaalistaja saattaa olla lähempänä kuin aavistatkaan!

programme.title: Havaijin hait
programme.desc: Alue on paratiisi yhdelle maailman väärinymmärretyimmistä olennoista eli haille. Jopa 40 lajia asuu näissä vesissä. Niissä on myös kotonaan maailmakuulu villieläinten luontokuvaaja Paul Atkins. Ohjelma johdattaa meidät Waikikin rannoilta kaukaiselle riutalle Havaijin saaristoon. programme.title: Tappajakäärmeet
programme.desc: Eräs käärmesuku tuottaa voimakasta neurotoksista myrkkyä, ja se tappaa enemmän ihmisiä kuin mikään muu käärmesuku maapallolla. Tutkijat ympäri maailmaa pyrkivät selvittämään, miten.

programme.title: Alaskan lentopelastajat
programme.desc: Lentokoneet ovat Alaskan elinehto. Ne kuljettavat tarvikkeita ja pelastavat loukkaantuneita ja eksyneitä paikoista, jonne ei vie teitä. Rankat sääilmiöt ja äärimmäiset maastot tekevät alueesta maan vaarallisimman. Tutustu lentäjiin, jotka tekevät kaikkensa hoitaakseen homman. Kolmiosainen ohjelma Alaskan lentäjistä tutkii vaarallisen ammatin saloja ja sitä, mitä riskejä lentäjät kohtaavat.

programme.title: Ihmeellinen planeetta Maa
programme.desc: Astronaut Chris Hadfield has left the planet three times already, now he wants to do more. After seeing the bullet holes left by asteroids on our planet's surface, he believes our only chance of survival is to escape Earth and build a colony off-world. But it will be the toughest journey humanity has ever faced: space radiation, microgravity and the bacteria inside us will conspire against us. So could we earthlings ever survive off our one strange rock?

programme.title: Vendée Globe Weekly Highlights
programme.desc: To date, the VENDÉE GLOBE is the only solo sailing race around the world that is non-stop and without assistance. The event followed in the wake of the Golden Globe that initiated the first circumnavigation of this type via the three capes (Good Hope, Leeuwin and Horn) in 1968. 44,996 kilometres, or 24,296 miles. That is the circumference of the Earth. The Vendée Globe accomplishes in 74 days this planetary voyage as participants sail down the Atlantic, across the Indian and face the challenges of the Pacific Ocean. The public refer to this arduous competition as the Everest of the seas, and this 9th edition will see 33 contenders depart from Les Sables-d’ Olonne to take part in a life changing competition.Follow the highlights of what happens weekly in the Vendée Globe as challengers sail to the journey of their lives.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: We arrive to Spain for the GC32 Mar Menor Cup! The crews are ready for a grandiose final of the season as this is their last chance to improve their standings. Precision, coordination and pure skill is of essence, and Spanish waters will prove to be harder to navigate than expected. Will Allinghi take the overall victory?Watch the best moments of the GC32 Mar Menor Cup 2021.

programme.title: Le Défi Azimut
programme.desc: One month before the Vendée Globe 2016, the best Imoca skippers were able to test their boat for the last time during the sixth edition of the Défi Azimut. Every year, this festive weekend provides an opportunity for all stakeholders in ocean sailing to see the Imoca 60 boats and to meet their skipper on the dock.

programme.title: Surf Series: South Africa
programme.desc: The penultimate event of the South African Surf Series takes place at Pollock Beach. This is one of the highlights of the WSL Africa tour and features a Women’s QS 3000, Men’s QS 1000 and Junior Men and Women’s QS 1000 rated events. With a field of top international and local surfers, this event is bound to heat up as the best South African Surfers face off some formidable opponents. Fierce competition may see some position changes ahead of the final event of the series.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Tour
programme.desc: Broadcast of Wingfoil World Tour.

programme.title: Un día en...Salón Internacional Náutico de Barcelona
programme.desc: A day at...International Barcelona Boat Show.During the 4 days of the exhibition, you can discover more than 275 international exhibitors and almost 700 boats on the water, and many more boats at the show.

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar
programme.desc: We begin this day of discoveries with a visit to the most important historical landmarks in Stone Town. For lunch, we head straight on to The Rock: one of Zanzibar's greatest icons. The restaurant was literally built on a rock and can only be reached on foot during the low tide. Then, we will follow Shabed's suggestion and dive into the water to try all the activities available.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: In this episode of Sail-Ho Croatia we are continuing our adventure journeying through beautiful islands of the Zadar archipelago. We will first stop in Biograd, the host of the largest Boat Show in this part of Europe. After that, we’ll visit the stunning islands of Olib, Silba and Premuda and head over to Ugljan and Pašman. Stay with us!

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The story of Split has been going on for 17 centuries, ever since the Roman emperor Diocletian decided to build a palace on this peninsula. Today, it offers tourists with an attractive and rich tradition, magnificent history, cultural heritage and beautiful nature. This is why Split is considered an unmissable destination in the Adriatic. Stay tuned in our new episode of Sail-Ho!

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Wind Masters

From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: EcoFin Documentary
programme.desc: Two young innovators created the first sustainable surfboard fin based on ocean-recycled plastics. In this stunning documentary they prove their mission and reveal a transparent value chain of the waste material to design a performance product for surfers. The unrivaled story is underlined by surfing, adventure and great personalities.

programme.title: Sailing to the Games
programme.desc: Follow sailors from around the world as they prepare to compete on the world's greatest sporting stage and make history at the 2024 Olympic Games in Paris.

programme.title: Sailing to the Games
programme.desc: Follow sailors from around the world as they prepare to compete on the world's greatest sporting stage and make history at the 2024 Olympic Games in Paris.

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes
programme.desc: In this episode we will visit the old town and the palace of the grand master, before we refresh ourselves in the Kallithea Springs, and discover why Rhodes is considered as the sailing Mecca of the Dodecanese. We’ll take a trip to the beautiful Stegna beach to dive in the immaculate crystal blue waters, before venturing out on a SUP, a stand-up paddle board, to experience the unique and ever-growing practice of SUP Yoga. Finally, we’ll visit Panagia Tsambika, a hilltop monastery considered by some to be miracle-working.

programme.title: Discovering Saint Maarten
programme.desc: The island of Saint Maarten is one of the most captivating island of the entire Caribbean. Being split into two nationalities, while hosting many more, a hub of diverse excitement is brought there. Experience a 12 meter sailboat race, planes flying 50 overhead on a crystal blue watered beach, a long street filled with cultural fusion, a wildlife tour, and a underwater helmet-diving excursion by the side of a helicopter and submarine wreck.

programme.title: Maxiboat TV Show
programme.desc: In this episode 8 of Maxiboat, we dive into the world of ocean racing and the Ultimates category with these real F1 boats that distinguished themselves in the last Transat Jacques Vabre. Then we visit the Prestige Yachts in Vendée, France, to discover the X Line series and especially the brand new X60, a French motor-yacht in the era of time. Back to the Cannes Yachting Festival, we try out two brands in the spotlight: the Turkish shipyard Sirena Marine and its brand new Sirena 68 and then Zeelander, another high-end lobster brand from the Netherlands. Come on board with us!

programme.title: Jump On Board
programme.desc: Welcome to this new season of Jump on Board! Our journey begins in Athens: in the Temple of Poseidon. Ancient travelers used to come here and ask for the favours of the god of the sea before their journey. Let's begin!

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: In this episode of Sail-Ho Croatia we are continuing our adventure journeying through beautiful islands of the Zadar archipelago. We will first stop in Biograd, the host of the largest Boat Show in this part of Europe. After that, we’ll visit the stunning islands of Olib, Silba and Premuda and head over to Ugljan and Pašman. Stay with us!

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The story of Split has been going on for 17 centuries, ever since the Roman emperor Diocletian decided to build a palace on this peninsula. Today, it offers tourists with an attractive and rich tradition, magnificent history, cultural heritage and beautiful nature. This is why Split is considered an unmissable destination in the Adriatic. Stay tuned in our new episode of Sail-Ho!

programme.title: Surf Series: South Africa
programme.desc: The penultimate event of the South African Surf Series takes place at Pollock Beach. This is one of the highlights of the WSL Africa tour and features a Women’s QS 3000, Men’s QS 1000 and Junior Men and Women’s QS 1000 rated events. With a field of top international and local surfers, this event is bound to heat up as the best South African Surfers face off some formidable opponents. Fierce competition may see some position changes ahead of the final event of the series.

programme.title: Vendée Globe Weekly Highlights
programme.desc: To date, the VENDÉE GLOBE is the only solo sailing race around the world that is non-stop and without assistance. The event followed in the wake of the Golden Globe that initiated the first circumnavigation of this type via the three capes (Good Hope, Leeuwin and Horn) in 1968. 44,996 kilometres, or 24,296 miles. That is the circumference of the Earth. The Vendée Globe accomplishes in 74 days this planetary voyage as participants sail down the Atlantic, across the Indian and face the challenges of the Pacific Ocean. The public refer to this arduous competition as the Everest of the seas, and this 9th edition will see 33 contenders depart from Les Sables-d’ Olonne to take part in a life changing competition.Follow the highlights of what happens weekly in the Vendée Globe as challengers sail to the journey of their lives.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: We arrive to Spain for the GC32 Mar Menor Cup! The crews are ready for a grandiose final of the season as this is their last chance to improve their standings. Precision, coordination and pure skill is of essence, and Spanish waters will prove to be harder to navigate than expected. Will Allinghi take the overall victory?Watch the best moments of the GC32 Mar Menor Cup 2021.

programme.title: Le Défi Azimut
programme.desc: One month before the Vendée Globe 2016, the best Imoca skippers were able to test their boat for the last time during the sixth edition of the Défi Azimut. Every year, this festive weekend provides an opportunity for all stakeholders in ocean sailing to see the Imoca 60 boats and to meet their skipper on the dock.

programme.title: Rolex Spirit Of Yachting
programme.desc: For year now, Rolex sailing competitions across the globe have united the top sailors in different boat classes. From the impressive fast-paced SailGP Grand Prixes to the long-distance Rolex Fastnet Race, there is a different competition for all. Rolex Spirit of Yachting collects the best moments, most emblematic venues and distinguished personalities together under the same show to rewatch the best moments of important sailing competitions all over the world. Get ready to splash into the Giraglia Cup action, jump onboard in the Middle Sea Race or set sail into the unknown Sydney-Hobart Yacht Race.

programme.title: Atlantic Cup
programme.desc: The second leg of the race goes from New York City to New Port City, Rhode Island. There are two major challenges on this leg: one is getting out of New York Harbour, dealing with the tides and the thicker winds that come off the city, and the other is dealing with the commercial traffic, as it is one of the busiest ports in the world. How will the skippers manage?

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: EcoFin Documentary
programme.desc: Two young innovators created the first sustainable surfboard fin based on ocean-recycled plastics. In this stunning documentary they prove their mission and reveal a transparent value chain of the waste material to design a performance product for surfers. The unrivaled story is underlined by surfing, adventure and great personalities.

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes
programme.desc: In this episode we will visit the old town and the palace of the grand master, before we refresh ourselves in the Kallithea Springs, and discover why Rhodes is considered as the sailing Mecca of the Dodecanese. Finally, we’ll visit Panagia Tsambika, a hilltop monastery considered by some to be miracle-working.

programme.title: Postcards from Paros
programme.desc: Welcome to Paros, one of the islands in the Aegean Sea nestled between the Cyclades. Word spreads fast that Paros is one of the trendiest and most diverse islands in Greece, so we will be discovering more about this island’s history, culture and nautical destinations.Discover Paros flavours and visit the environmental and cultural part of Pars, protected for its indigenous fauna and flora, its positions in history and, of course, its marvellous beaches. Send Postcards from Paros, a pearl in the Aegean Sea worth discovering.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The Crikvenica Riviera is one of the most scenic parts of the Adriatic coast with a rich diversity of attractive beaches, green hinterland, a continental wooden area, a climate that provides perfect refreshment in the summer time and just the right amount of action-packed fun in the sun. programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Welcome, sailors! In this episode of Sail-ho Croatia we arrive to the incredibly beautiful, fragrant and action-packed island of Cres. programme.title: Chef On Board
programme.desc: Lapo and his Captain are sailing to Pianosa, a very remote and exclusive Island. As it is a prison island, boats cannot come within a mile radius. This means Lapo is on a solo mission. Lapo will meet the prisoners who are keeping the island pristine but taking care of it’s natural fauna and flora. He will cook with ingredients from the prison garden and learn a secret dish from one of the wardens. Will this impress the Captain?

programme.title: Chef On Board
programme.desc: Lapo arrives on Giglio Island where he meets a local fisherman who supplies the restaurants with their seafood. On their trip out to sea, Lapo learns about species of the area and how to fish sustainably. He finds his catch when a bunch of girls who come from America come to dine on board. Now, its the right time to remember everything he learnt from the Maestros.

programme.title: Check Up
programme.desc: La puntata è dedicata alle allergie. In apertura un approfondimento sulla rinite allergica con il prof. Luca Malvezzi, responsabile Otorinolaringoiatria all'Humanitas San Pio X Milano, che illustra cause e sintomi di una delle forme allergiche più diffuse. A seguire, si parla di esofagite eosinofila, patologia cronica dell'esofago spesso confusa con il reflusso gastroesofageo, che negli ultimi anni ha registrato un grande incremento dei casi. A spiegarne le caratteristiche è il prof. Silvio Danese, direttore di Gastroenterologia ed Endoscopia digestiva all'Ospedale San Raffaele di Milano. Successivamente, le problematiche dermatologiche legate all'ipersensibilità cutanea. Dermatiti, arrossamenti e irritazioni sono al centro dell'intervento della dott.ssa Lucia Lospalluti, dermatologa presso l'Azienda Universitaria Ospedaliera Policlinico di Bari. Spazio anche ad allergie e intolleranze alimentari. Mangiare è un gesto quotidiano, ma alcuni cibi possono diventare un pericolo per la salute. A parlarne è la prof.ssa Renata Bracale, docente di Nutrizione Umana presso l'Università del Molise. Spazio poi alla malattia correlata alle IgG4, una patologia infiammatoria che negli ultimi anni è stata oggetto di crescente attenzione da parte della comunità scientifica. A illustrarne le caratteristiche è il prof. Luca Frulloni, Prof. Ordinario di Gastroenterologia dell'Università di Verona. La ricerca fornisce trattamenti sempre più mirati ed efficaci, in grado non solo di alleviare i sintomi, ma anche di intervenire sui meccanismi responsabili delle patologie. A parlarne è la prof.ssa Claudia Volpi, docente di Farmacologia presso l'Università di Perugia. In chiusura, focus sull'angioedema ereditario, una malattia rara che può manifestarsi con gonfiori e arrossamenti. Il prof. Mauro Cancian, Direttore dell'Unità di Allergologia dell'Ospedale Università di Padova, spiega l'importanza di una diagnosi tempestiva e di un corretto percorso clinico.

programme.title: Linea Verde Estate
programme.desc: L'energia dei Campi Flegrei: Margherita Granbassi e Nicola 'Tinto' Prudente, proseguono il viaggio di Linea Verde nel territorio di Pozzuoli, in Campania. Dall'anfiteatro Flavio, terza arena più grande del mondo romano, alla Darsena per gustare il mitico cuoppo di alici fritte: a bordo di una vespetta vintage, per le vie di Pozzuoli, l'incontro dei nostri conduttori, pronti per una nuova avventura. Il respiro dei Campi Flegrei: camminando tra i resti e le antiche botteghe del tempio di Serapide, con una ricercatrice dell'INGV, alla ricerca dei segni inequivocabili del fenomeno del bradisismo. Natura, gusto e cultura: sul lago d'Averno, le potenzialità dell'agricoltura didattica, sostenibile e rigenerativa. Un periodo di abbandono negli anni 70 e, oggi, una fase di Rinascimento e valorizzazione: camminando per le caratteristiche vie, alla scoperta delle bellezze del Rione Terra, il quartiere più antico di Pozzuoli. A Bacoli, in un'azienda agricola, il racconto di una grande storia di famiglia, di vino e di una cantina nata tra antichi scavi romani sopravvissuti all'assalto del cemento. A Capo Miseno, nella cornice di uno dei punti più spettacolari e panoramici, la coltivazione e la raccolta dei pomodori cannellini, simbolo dell'agricoltura flegrea. Un'eccellenza del territorio e antica tradizione romana: nasce alla Casina Vanvitelliana il primo corso italiano per ostricari, nuova figura professionale che valorizza l'ostricoltura e la cultura del mare. L'inclusione che genera speranza: a Quarto, nell'area flegrea della Città Metropolitana di Napoli, il lavoro di un'associazione che, sui territori confiscati alla camorra, ha dato vita ad una realtà agricola e culinaria che sta aiutando diversi ragazzi speciali. Gran finale al porto di Pozzuoli, aspettando il traghetto per Ischia.

Währenddessen stehen Jonas und Johanna vor einem unlösbaren Problem mit dem Jugendclub, was die Jugendlichen dazu bringt, ihren Unmut lautstark kundzutun.

programme.title: Undercover Boss
programme.desc: Michael Gonzalez Salcedo ist seit 2010 Geschäftsführer bei der Daume Gruppe. Mit rund 1100 Beschäftigten erzielt sie im Bereich der Gebäudetechnik einen Jahresumsatz von rund 180 Millionen Euro. Aktuell ist besonders der anhaltende Fachkräftemangel eine der größten Herausforderungen für die Gruppe. Auf der Suche nach Optimierungspotential tarnt sich der Boss als TV-Show Kandidat Rafael und schuftet u.a. auf Großbaustellen und im Kundenservice.

programme.title: Undercover Boss
programme.desc: 'Bäckerei Dreißig' ist ein Familienunternehmen mit Sitz im brandenburgischen Guben. Die Geschäftsführerin Antje Dreißig ist für den Verkauf zuständig, ihr Ex-Mann Markus für die Produktion. Antje möchte sich ein genaues Bild von der Arbeit an der Basis verschaffen. Deshalb tarnt sie sich mit Extensions und einer randlosen Brille und arbeitet eine Woche undercover als Technikerin und in mehreren Filialen.

programme.title: SPIEGEL TV
programme.desc: Jugendgangs in Frankreich: Ehre, Messer, RevierkämpfeZwischen den Sozialbauten der Pariser Vorstädte gibt es unsichtbare Grenzen: Wer sie übertritt, riskiert nicht selten sein Leben. Denn Kämpfe zwischen Jugendbanden fordern in Frankreich immer wieder Tote. Vierzehn erstochene Teenager binnen eines Jahres lautet die Bilanz dieser extremen Form von Jugendgewalt. Die Täter sind oft erst zwölf oder 13 Jahre alt. Um die angebliche Ehre ihres Viertels zu verteidigen, sind sie zu allem bereit. Für viele Kids sind die Gangs oft der einzige Halt, wo ansonsten Tristesse herrscht. Die Polizei setzt auf Aufklärung und Sondereinheiten, um die Gewalt in den Griff zu bekommen - mit überschaubarem Erfolg.

programme.title: RTL Nachtjournal
programme.desc: Im Mittelpunkt des Nachrichtenjournals RTL Nachtjournal steht die vertiefende aktuelle Berichterstattung. Das Thema des Tages wird regelmäßig durch kritische Interviews mit Verantwortlichen aus Politik und Wirtschaft beleuchtet.

programme.title: Alltagskämpfer - So tickt Deutschland!
programme.desc: Drogen und Kriminalität belasten den Kölner Neumarkt. Einzelhändler wie Daniel Niklas kämpfen mit Umsatzeinbußen. Mit der Initiative Zukunft Neumarkt setzt er sich für Veränderungen ein und sucht nach Lösungen.

programme.title: Besser! So?
programme.desc: Staub, Lärm, schwere Maschinen - und ein Umgangston, der es in sich hat: Reporterin Lena wagt den Selbstversuch auf der Baustelle. Zwei Tage lang begleitet sie die 24-jährige Stuckateurin Lara, die ihren Beruf mit Leidenschaft ausübt und sich täglich gegen Vorurteile behaupten muss. Wie erlebt Lena den Alltag in einer Branche, die lange von Männern geprägt wurde? Ist die Baustelle längst moderner als ihr Ruf oder braucht es noch viel Veränderung?

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Pfadfinderinnen finden den Schwerverbrecher Carpenter gefesselt und erschlagen in seiner Wohnung.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Ein Junkie wird neben einer Spritze tot aufgefunden, die mit einer undefinierbaren Flüssigkeit gefüllt ist. Dessen Hände beginnen, sich zu zersetzen. Horatio ist klar, dass der Tote mit einer radioaktiven Substanz in Kontakt gekommen ist.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report - Einzeleinsätze
programme.desc: Ob Raubüberfall, Brandstiftung oder hilflose Personen - die Arbeit von Polizisten, Notärzten und Rettungssanitätern erfordert nicht nur Sachkenntnis, sondern auch Einfühlungsvermögen und Durchsetzungskraft. Häufig sind sie gemeinsam vor Ort, wenn rund um einen Polizeieinsatz medizinische Erstversorgung gefragt ist. Der Blaulicht Report erzählt Geschichten aus dem aufregenden Berufsalltag dieser Retter in Not.

programme.title: CSI: Den Tätern auf der Spur
programme.desc: Die Reporterin Heidi Custer wird an einem Straßenrand erwürgt aufgefunden. In ihrer Handtasche sind Fotos aller bisherigen Opfer von Dr. Jekyll. Eine Spur führt das CSI-Team zu einer verlassenen Halle mitten in der Wüste. Dort findet Nick zwar keinen Hinweis auf Dr. Jekyll, aber Blutspuren von Heidi Custer. Unterdessen erhält Ray einen Anruf aus dem Gefängnis: Der Serienkiller Nate Haskell bietet ihm an, Dr. Jekylls Identität zu offenbaren.

programme.title: CSI: Den Tätern auf der Spur
programme.desc: Der Serienkiller Nate Haskell erklärt sich bereit, Dr. Jekylls Identität zu offenbaren. Er gibt an, dass er Jekyll im Restaurant Venetti's kennengelernt hat. Auf einer Liste ehemaliger Mitarbeiter des Lokals zeigt Haskell auf einen Namen.

programme.title: CSI: Den Tätern auf der Spur
programme.desc: Officer Franklin Clark starb, als er und Nick versuchten, Dr. Jekyll zu verhaften. Bei seiner Beerdigung explodieren Bomben. Nicks Einsatz ist es zu verdanken, dass 'nur' zwei Menschen sterben. Langston hilft vom Krankenbett aus bei der Suche nach dem Täter mit. Eine Spur führt zu Aktivisten, die für ein 'gereinigtes Amerika' kämpfen. Alex McCann, der offenbar den Anschlag begangen hat, scheint weitere verheerende Attentate zu planen.

programme.title: Yhdeksäs komppania (7)
programme.desc: Colin Nutleyn läpimurtoelokuva. Hankalan armeija-ajan tiimellyksessä joukko inttipoikia keksii loistavan liikeidean, joka perustuu armeijan resursseihin. He pistävät pystyyn yrityksen, joka tekee koko joukon loistavia liiketoimia.

programme.title: P And B (12)
programme.desc: Pressun alla tapaavat Pettersson ja Bendel, rappeutuneina ja rahattomina. He lyöttäytyvät yhteen ja ovat pian matkalla ylöspäin yhteiskunnassa.

programme.title: Yrrol
programme.desc: Lorry-porukan hulvaton elokuva, jossa vilahtavat mm. alaosaton baarimikko, väkivaltainen lentoemäntä, viisi kirkuvaa Pelastusarmeijan sotilasta, sokea TV-kauppias, likainen tennispallo sekä tietenkin Bosse-setä - likaisempana kuin ikinä.

programme.title: Uusi maa (16)
programme.desc: Peter Birro ja Lukas Moodysson kirjoittivat tarinan kahdesta sankarista, Massoudista ja Alista, jotka yhdessä Louisen, entisen Miss Ruotsin kanssa matkustavat kesäisen maiseman läpi ja saavat Ruotsin näyttäytymään aivan uudessa valossa.

programme.title: Pelle flyttar till Komfusenbo (S)
programme.desc: Astrid Lindgrenin tarina 4-vuotiaasta pojasta, jota syytetään kynän hukkaamisesta ja joka päättää muuttaa pikkumökkiin puutarhan perälle.

programme.title: Ronja Ryövärintytär (7)
programme.desc: Ronjan elämä alkoi dramaattisesti. Kun hän syntyi, kalliolla ja metsissä salamoi, ja ryövärikuningas Mattis oli onnellinen, sillä se merkitsi sitä, että heimoon saatiin uusi ryövärijohtaja. Samana yönä Ronjalle kuitenkin syntyi kilpailija...

programme.title: Elämäni koirana (7)
programme.desc: Ingemar asuu veljensä ja sairaan äitinsä kanssa. Hänellä on vaikeaa, mutta ei niin vaikeaa kuin Laika-koiralla avaruudessa. Ingemar lähetetään kesäksi maalle isoäitinsä luokse. Siellä hän tapaa ihmisiä, jotta muuttavat hänen elämäänsä.

programme.title: Micke And Veronika (7)
programme.desc: Veronica rakastuu korviaan myöten Mikeen, puuseppään, joka remontoi Veronican luksusasunnon keittiötä. Heidän teini-ikäiset lapsensa Fanny ja Alexander eivät kuitenkaan innostu liitosta, joten heidän on paljon vaikeampaa hyväksyä se.

programme.title: En enkel till Antibes (12)
programme.desc: Draama leskimies Georgesta, joka saa tarpeekseen ihmisistä ympärillään, pakkaa laukun ja lähtee huikealle matkalle.

programme.title: Arn - Pohjoinen valtakunta (12)
programme.desc: Saagan toisessa osassa Arn jättää Jerusalemin ja palaa kotiinsa tavatakseen rakkaansa Cecilian. He menevät naimisiin ja perustavat perheen, mutta ajat eivät ole suinkaan vakaat -sota uhkaa puhjeta minä hetkenä hyvänsä.

programme.title: Vi hade i alla fall tur med vädret - igen (7)
programme.desc: Melkein 30 vuoden tauon jälkeen Rolf Skoglund ja Claire Wikholm ovat taas tien päällä. Luvassa on kaoottinen asuntovaunumatka, johon kuuluu vihaisia raggareita, raivokohtauksia, kiimainen opettaja ja tappelu Kolmårdenin eläintarhassa.

programme.title: Kocken
programme.desc: Vuosi 1969. 18-vuotias Martin on kakkoskokkina Kapkaupunkiin matkaavalla rahtilaivalla. Keittiössä määrää kuitenkin ensikokki Peter Stein, jonka julmia sääntöjä on toteltava. Martin ei aavista mikä odottaa häntä ja kokkioppilas Sundsvallia.

programme.title: Uhka (16)
programme.desc: Lasse Brudell on vastaava ohjelmoija Vidselin lentotukikohdassa Norrbottenissa. Hän työskentelee huippusalaisen JAS Gripeniin liittyvän EWS-puolustusjärjestelmän parissa. Majuri Haglund, karaistunut sotaveteraani, johtaa armeijan erikoisjoukkoja. Miesten tiet kohtaavat, kun Haglund kutsutaan nostamaan turvatoimien tasoa Gripenin ulkomaisille ostajaehdokkaille valmisteltavaa esittelyä varten.

programme.title: Komisario Beck tähtäimessä (16)
programme.desc: Komisario Beck tähtäimessä on kaikkein ensimmäinen elokuva komisario Martin Beckistä. Mestariteoksen takana on Bo Widerberg. Martin Beckin roolissa nähdään Carl Gustaf Lindstedt.

programme.title: 438 dagar (16)
programme.desc: Toimittajat Martin Schibbye ja Johan Persson pistävät kaiken peliin ylittäessään Somalian ja Etiopian välisen rajan. Heidän tarkoituksenaan on tutkia kuinka öljyn etsintä vaikuttaa paikallisväestöön.

programme.title: Tommy (16)
programme.desc: Viikkoa ennen joulua laskeutuu Estelle Svensson Tukholman Arlandaan. Vuotta aiemmin joutui hän pakenemaan tyttärensä ja aviomiehensä Tommyn kanssa ulkomaille, kun aviomies oli suunnitellut ja toteuttanut Ruotsin rikoshistorian kaikkien aikojen suurimman pankkiryöstön.

programme.title: Sean Banan inuti Seanfrika
programme.desc: Sean Banan lähtee Afrikkaan kuvaamaan musiikkivideota. Kaoottinen matka sisältää venejahteja, villieläimiä ja omituisia kohtaamisia.

programme.title: Miss Sweden (12)
programme.desc: 19-vuotias Moa (Alexandra Dahlström) elää tekee kaikkensa sulautuakseen joukkoon, mutta huomaakin olevansa kiinnostunut vääristä tyypeistä, kuuntelevansa vääränlaista musiikkia ja tekevänsä vääriä valintoja. Kun kaveritkin tuntuvat pitävän häntä vain pilkan kohteena, Moa saa tarpeekseen. Ohjaus: Tova Magnusson-Norling. Käsikirjoitus: Sara Kadefors.

programme.title: Mig äger ingen (12)
programme.desc: Ruotsi vuonna 1970. Lisa varttuu terästehtaalla työskentelevän Hasse-isänsä kanssa. Äiti jättää perheen, ja Hasse vajoaa syvemmälle murheisiin ja alkoholismiin. Isän ja tyttären välinen rakkaus ei silti haalistu. Mikael Persbrandt tekee yhden parhaista rooleistaan.

programme.title: Yhdeksäs komppania (7)
programme.desc: Colin Nutleyn läpimurtoelokuva. Hankalan armeija-ajan tiimellyksessä joukko inttipoikia keksii loistavan liikeidean, joka perustuu armeijan resursseihin. He pistävät pystyyn yrityksen, joka tekee koko joukon loistavia liiketoimia.

programme.title: Syyssonaatti (12)
programme.desc: Tunnettu pianisti Charlotte Andergast on juuri menettänyt miehensä. Hän matkustaa Eva-tyttärensä luokse. Siellä hän tapaa myös toisen tyttärensä Helenan, jonka hän on sijoittanut mielisairaalaan mutta jonka Eva on halunnut ottaa luokseen.

programme.title: Krakel Spektakel
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen koko perheen musikaalielokuva Annabell Olssonin seikkailuista. Perustuu Lennart Hellsingin teksteihin ja Poul Ströyerin kuvitukseen.

programme.title: Yhteinen onni
programme.desc: Johan työskentelee isänsä tilalla ja elää onnellisesti Anna-Karinin kanssa. Kun he menevät naimisiin, Johanin isä haluaa siirtää tilansa pojalleen. Johan ja Anna-Karin haluavat kuitenkin ensisijaisesti lapsia - hinnalla millä hyvänsä!

programme.title: Uutisreportteri Morgan Pålsson (12)
programme.desc: Epäpätevä ruotsalaistoimittaja valokuvaajineen joutuu ainoana ulkomaalaistiiminä keskelle sotilasvallankaappausta pienessä afrikkalaisessa maassa.

programme.title: UFO Sweden (12)
programme.desc: Nuorisokotiin sijoitettu kapinallinen teini Denise epäilee, ettei hänen isänsä ole oikeasti kuollut, vaan ufot ovat kidnapanneet hänet. Niinpä hän pyytää ufoja tutkivan UFO Sweden -järjestön apua, jotta totuus selviäisi. Tämä johtaa vaaralliseen seikkailuun, joka vie Denisen kauas lain rajojen ulkopuolelle - uforetkien, salaliittojen ja selittämättömien ilmiöiden maailmaan.

programme.title: Vaahteramäen Eemeli (7)
programme.desc: Eemeli haluaa vain hyvää, mutta silti kaikki hänen puuhansa päättyvät kaaokseen. Kun hänen isänsä huutaa EEMELIIII, huuto raikaa kaikkialla Kissankulmassa.

programme.title: Britt-Marie kävi täällä (S)
programme.desc: Kun 63-vuotias kaavoihin kangistunut Britt-Marie jättää miehensä 40 avioliittovuoden jälkeen, hän joutuu kohtaamaan muuttuneen maailman. Hän päätyy ankeaan Borgin syrjäkylään, jossa elämä tuntuu junnaavan paikoillaan niillä harvoilla, jotka kylää vielä asuttavat. Siellä piilee kuitenkin suuria unelmia, jotka herättävät Britt-Marien syvälle haudatun uskon tulevaan. Ehkä elämä antaa uuden mahdollisuuden. Ehkä koskaan ei ole liian myöhäistä alkaa elää.

programme.title: Mies, joka rakasti järjestystä (12)
programme.desc: 59-vuotias Ove on kärttyinen naapurikyttääjä. Koominen ja sydämellinen tarina saa alkunsa, kun viimeisillään raskaana oleva Parvaneh muuttaa perheineen vastapäiseen taloon ja peruuttaa päin Oven postilaatikkoa.
Toinen maailmansota on puhkeamassa. Värmlantilainen Annika saapuu Tukholmaan ja aloittaa suhteen rikkaan miehen kanssa.

programme.title: Hamilton - kansakunnan puolesta (16)
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen toimintatrilleri perustuu Jan Guilloun romaaniin. Mikael Persbrandt esittää erityisagentti Carl Hamiltonia.

programme.title: Seuramatka (S)
programme.desc: Kanarian saarilla on joulun aikaan sikajuhlat, ja siellä Stig Helmer Olsson on ensimmäisellä ulkomaanmatkallaan. Hän ei tiedä että tohtori Levander, joka on hoitanut hänen lentopelkoaan, on huijannut häntä tuomaan saarille pimeästi rahaa.

programme.title: Kaisa Kullanmuru (S)
programme.desc: Kaisa auttaa mummoaan myymään polkkakaramelleja torilla. Eräänä päivänä mummon jalka kipeytyy, ja Kaisan on hoidettava karamellimyynti aivan itse. Mitenköhän hän selviää tehtävästä?

programme.desc: Viekö porilainen voiton? Kymppitonnissa kisaamassa itsevarmuutta uhkuvat juontaja Juuso ”Köpi” Kallio, rap-artisti View, tanssija Katri Mäkinen, ohjaaja Aleksi Delikouras ja toimittaja Noora Shingler. Ohjelman juontaa aina yhtä sensuelli Cristal Snow.

programme.desc: Radioäänet Kimmo Vehviläinen, Minna Kuukka ja Jupe Tuomola testaavat kipukynnystään ja tietojaan studiossa vakiokilpailija Eero Ritalan kanssa. Teemoina pakanat ja Turku. Sähköiskuja ja pisteitä jakelee Juha Perälä.

programme.title: Silent Library Suomi

programme.title: Sampo ja kotivideot
programme.desc: Tänään säätiedotus lupaa murokuuroja, Samantha taistelee Sabrinaa vastaan ja Reijo erehtyy bideestä. Lentävän kesämökkimme vieraana on eräjormien kanoottikuningas Hamza El Issaoui! Kausi 3, jakso 16.

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Kontiosalo ja Vaarala etsivät mielisairaalasta kadonnutta miestä Ranualla. Kaipainen ja Airaksinen paimentavat juhlijoita Kilpisjärvellä.

programme.title: Stepan Flagar - DJAZZ Portrait: Ostrich Quartet
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts. They revive the memory of the festival, the music and the experience.

programme.title: Antiánima - jazzahead! 2024 - Antiánima
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead! paid special attention to the jazz scene of the Netherlands and invited over forty jazz acts to perform over the course of three days. Among the ensembles presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2024 is contemporary Mexican jazz trio Antiánima. Antiánima was founded in 2019 and has since become known for its adventurous blend of musical styles, incorporating elements from contemporary jazz, punk, free jazz, progressive rock, electronic, and hip hop. Antiánima explores an audio-visual concept that integrates MIDI-controlled visuals with their performances. The lineup includes Ángel Herrera Rivera (bass), Samuel de Jesús Sánchez Alvarado (drums), and Luis Ángel Orduña Gutiérrez (guitar).

programme.title: Maceo Plex - Audio Obscura x Rijksmuseum
programme.desc: The American DJ/producer - known for his enigmatic combinations of grooving, melancholic and ecstatic house and techno - visited the museum for some ground-level inspiration, and will share this during this once a lifetime event under the ever so stunning Rijksmuseum. This is the first time the museum collaborates on a project that revolves around electronic music, matching its vision to inspire visitors and to let them experience art in exciting new ways Initiated by Audio Obscura, this is the next step in connecting world-class artists with legendary, historical locations.

programme.title: François Bourassa, Guy Boisvert, Andre Leroux And Guillaume Pilote - jazzahead! 2022 - Francois Bourassa Quartet
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead! paid special attention to Canada’s jazz scene and invited forty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. Among the performing bands is the François Bourassa Quartet. With ten albums of original music and multiple awards, jazz pianist François Bourassa is an international ambassador for Canada’s thriving jazz community. Taking inspiration from a diversity of sources, this award-winning quartet has been a staple of Montreal’s artistic landscape for a quarter of a century. The band features bassist Guy Boisvert, saxophonist André Leroux and drummer Guillaume Pilote.

programme.title: Norayr Kartashyan, Grigor Kartashyan, Artur Mkrtumyan And Edgar Petrosyan - Norayr Kartashyan And Menua - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Norayr Kartashyan, is acclaimed as one of Armenia’s finest woodwind masters and composers, an acknowledged virtuoso numerous traditional Armenian instruments. To name a few: the blul and shvi flutes, duduk, the double-reed zurna trumpet, the pku clarinet, and the parkapzuk bagpipe. Kartashyan’s compositions are gently unfolding, delicately intertwined evocations of rural music with a timeless connection to the earth, full of beauty and warmth.

programme.title: Runtown - Runtown - La Machine de Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Enjoy Runtown’s first concert in Paris, where the Nigerian superstar brings many guests to his show. One of the most talented Nigerian afrobeat scenes will make you rediscover his greatest hits. Nigeria is a very creative country when it comes to the music scene. Runtown is no exception. His first single, “Party Like It’s 1980,” paved the way for “Gallardo,” which caught the entire international scene's attention. Runtown’s inspiration comes from the greats, from Salif Keita and Fela Kuti to Otis Redding and Bob Marley. An exceptional event not to be missed.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle, Daniel Barenboim And Berliner Philharmoniker - Europa Konzert 2004 – Athens
programme.desc: Europakonzert 2004 was held in Athens, Greece. This concert featured the Berliner Philharmoniker performing live at the ancient Herodes Atticus Theatre along with an interesting combination of conductor and soloist - Sir Simon Rattle wielding the baton as pianist Daniel Barenboim plays Johannes Brahms’ Piano Concerto No. 1 and Arnold Schoenberg's arrangement of Brahms' Piano Quartet No 1. The Athens concert marked a double première: it was the first Europakonzert under the direction of the new chief conductor, as well as the first time Rattle and Barenboim appeared together. The Odeon of Herodes Atticus, an amphitheatre built in 161 AD in memory of Herodes Atticus’ wife, is situated on the slope of the Acropolis. With a seating capacity of at least 5,000 spectators, it was reputed to be the finest theatre in all of Greece.

programme.title: Verônica Ferriani - MPB Sessions - Verônica Ferriani
programme.desc: Verônica Ferriani is a Brazilian singer and songwriter recognized for her powerful voice and distinctive musical identity. Her career spans a variety of styles within MPB (Brazilian Popular Music), and she stands out for the intensity and emotion of her performances. In her shows, Verônica presents a mix of works inspired by personal experiences, tributes to her major influences, and selections from her own compositions. How do contemporary artists reinterpret tradition and create new forms of expression within MPB? Da Pá Virada Sessions' MPB Series investigates this question. Hosted by Dani Gurgel, this episode features a live performance and thought-provoking conversation with Verônica Ferriani, exploring her unique fusion of styles and inviting audiences to discover the richness of modern Brazilian music. Continue your journey into the rich world of contemporary Brazilian popular music with Stingray DJAZZ.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon, George Gruntz, Guy Pedersen And Daniel Humair - Long Tall Dexter Live in '64
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 And '64 features three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. These shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano), and jazz classics “Blues Walk”, “A Night In Tunisia”, “Body And Soul”, and others. One of the most influential saxophonists in jazz history, Dexter Gordon is captured in sharp form and style in this 70-minute tour de force.

programme.title: China Moses, Joe Armon Jones And Luke Wynter - China Moses: 'Whatever' at Jazz à Ramatuelle
programme.desc: In 1988, Dee Dee Bridgewater was one of the first great jazz singers to perform at the Jazz Festival in Ramatuelle. In 2016, the story seems to repeat itself as her daughter China Moses took the stage at Ramatuelle. Over the years, China Moses has become a mature performer with a unique style: rocky voice, sharp sense of swing, and intense/energetic stage presence. After signing compilations dedicated to Dinah Washington and blues, Moses released in 2016 an album of his own compositions, entitled Whatever. Get ready for a most entertaining performance combining jazz, soul, and hip-hop.

programme.title: Various - Documentary 2017
programme.desc: This short documentary follows the participants of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world. In doing so, it has become one of the prominent gateways to the international professional classical music scene for young musicians. The International Franz Liszt Piano Competition was founded in 1986 in the Netherlands and has since built a reputation as one of the world’s most prestigious piano competitions.

programme.title: Manel Fortià, Antonia Lizana, Pere Martínez And Max Villavecchia - Libérica Arrels
programme.desc: Having played in New York with jazz icons Dave Liebman, Eliot Zigmund, Ari Hoenig, and Chris Cheek, Catalan bass player Manel Fortià now returns to his roots to reinvent traditional Catalan repertoire. Manel Fortià teams up with Antonia Lizana (saxophones), Pere Martínez (vocals), Max Villavecchia (piano), and Raphael Pannier (drums) to form ‘Libérica’, reimagining Catalan music and Flamenco through the eyes of a New York jazz musician. Their 2021 album ‘Arrels’ explores Catalan hymns, including ‘El cant dels ocells’ and ‘Els tres tambors’, heard here during a live performance at Nova Jazz Cava in Barcelona.

programme.title: Lang Lang - Lang Lang – The Third Dimension
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Lang Lang performs some of the greatest works in the piano repertoire at Berghain in Berlin in 2010. The concert program includes the first movement of Piano Sonata No. 23, op. 57, called Beethoven's Appassionata, the precipato of Prokofiev's Sonata No. 7, and the mention of Iberia (Book 1), the masterpiece of Isaac Albéniz. Lang Lang closes the evening with a powerful version of the ''Heroic'' Polonaise, op. 53 from Chopin.

programme.title: Philippe Jaroussky - Telemann - Der am Ölberg zagende Jesus, TWV 1: 364
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries. The works performed in this film are Telemann's Jesus liegt in letzten Zügen and Sinfonia from Brockes-Passion; Der am Ölberg zagende Jesus, and Bach's Sinfonia from Ich hatte viel Bekümmernis and Ich habe genug.

programme.title: Oum El-Ghait Benessahraoui, Yacir Rami, Damian Nueva Cortes And Camille Passeri - Oum - Music Meeting Festival 2018
programme.desc: Oum El Ghait Benessahraoui, who is better known as Oum, gives a unique glance at ethnic Morrocan musical esthetics. The singer-songwriter is considered to be the ambassador of Morrocan culture, too. Deeply influenced by gospel, jazz, soul and RAndB genres, today Oum mixes more and more African music genres, such as Sufi, Hassani, or Afrobeat. Yet, the singer’s voice still echoes the colours of Aretha Franklin, Ella Fitzgerald or Whitney Houston. It is the African American vocal tradition that made a huge impact on Oum since her early days as the singer. Performing from Music Meeting Festival in Nijmegen, The Netherlands, Oum charms the stage with an exotic sonic journey to the undiscovered lands of North Africa.

programme.title: Tedi Papavrami - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Margaret Price, Orchester der Ludwigsburger Schlossfestspiele And Wolfgang Gönnenwein - Mahler - Rückert-Lieder
programme.desc: Welsh soprano Margaret Price performs Gustav Mahler’s Rückert-Lieder. She is accompanied by the Orchester der Ludwigsburger Schloßfestspiele under the baton of Wolfgang Gönnenwein. Mahler’s Rückert-Lieder are a collection of five songs based on poetry of Friedrich Rückert (1788-1866). Mahler completed both a piano and an orchestral version of the first four songs during the summer of 1901, but he never got around to orchestrating the fifth song, “Liebst du um Schönheit” (‘Lovest thou but beauty’). Mahler wrote this overt love song for his bride Alma Schindler. This performance was recorded at the 1988 Ludwigsburger Schloßfestspiele.

programme.title: Daniel Harding - Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor Op. 81
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms’s Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’. Brahms composed his concert overture during the summer of 1880. With its dark and tumultuous character, it could be regarded as the serious counterpart of his more joyful Academic Festival Overture, Op. 80. Mahler completed his first symphony eight years later, in 1888. Originally a five-movement piece, the composer discarded the second movement ‘Blumine’ some years later, resulting in the final four-movement version we know today. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Vincent Courtois, Jeroen van Vliet And Sanne Rambags - Paradox Live: Carte Blanche of Sanne Rambags
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox. From young, local talents to top national and international artists, PARADOX Tilburg is the most intimate jazz club in the Netherlands, with a devoted audience from all across Europe. In their TV show PARADOX LIVE you get a taste of the greatest concerts and interviews with artists from all around the world. This episode of PARADOX LIVE presents the talented Dutch jazz singer Sanne Rambags accompanied by Jeroen van Vliet (piano) and Vincent Courtois (cello).

programme.title: Mario Batkovic - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Mario Batkovic, aims to explore the sonic possibilities of the accordion, without effects or loops, rather through a mutualist symbiotic relationship between man and instrument. Challenging, hypnotic, and grandiose, Batkovic’s single-handed symphonic vision is certainly unique.

programme.title: Hartmut Haenchen, Stefan Vladar And Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach Chamber Orchestra - A Mozart Concert from Berlin
programme.desc: The Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach Chamber Orchestra delivers a program entirely devoted to Mozart at the Konzerthaus in Berlin under the direction of Hartmut Haenchen. In reduced form, the ensemble manages to bring to life the many characteristics of the music and the unique spirit of the famous composer, be it his gaiety of heart, his lyricism, his dramatic side or his polyphonic writing inspired. Criticism has always praised Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach's stylistic assurance, transparency of textures and technical precision. The extraordinary sensitivity and ease of Stefan Vladar make him an ideal partner for Haenchen and his orchestra. The evening's program includes Divertimento, K. 113; the Concerto for Piano and Orchestra No. 20, K. 466, and Symphony No. 41, K. 551.

programme.title: Hardwell - I Am Hardwell
programme.desc: When his debut artist album “United We Are” came out in 2015, DJ Hardwell kicked off his new world tour “I Am Hardwell - United We Are” at the Ziggo Dome. Spanning 6 continents, the sold-out tour stopped in Jakarta, Singapore, Bangalore, Mumbai, Lisbon, London, Mexico City, Cape Town, Johannesburg, Tel Aviv, Guatemala City, Manchester, Edinburgh, Belfast, Istanbul, Sao Paulo, Brisbane, Melbourne, and Sydney. On August 27th 2016, the Hockenheimring was soaked in electronic dance music. With over 100,000 people attending, Hardwell has set Southern Germany aglow with the biggest light installation of the world!

programme.title: Ana Carolina Coutinho And Megumi Kuroda - IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Schubert, Ullmann a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Ana Carolina Coutinho (Brazil, 1993) and pianist Megumi Kuroda (Japan, 1989) perform Franz Schubert’s Die Blumensprache, D. 519; ‘Sonnenuntergang’ from Viktor Ullmann’s Drei Hölderlin-Lieder; ‘Verschwiegene Liebe’ from Hugo Wolf’s Eichendorff-Lieder; ‘Il vole’ and ‘Fleurs’ from Francis Poulenc’s Fiançailles pour rire, FP 101; ‘Wasserrose’ from Richard Strauss’s Mädchenblumen, Op. 22; Kōsaku Yamada’s 風に乗せてうたへる春の歌八章; たたえよ、しらべよ、歌いつれよ;and Bart Visman’s Vermeer’s Gold, during the semi-finals of the International Vocal Competition 2021 – Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Het Noordbrabants Museum in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.

programme.title: The Ensemble HOPE - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Ensemble HOPE
programme.desc: The Ensemble HOPE is dedicated to the performance and creation of music of today. As well as exploring new forms of contemporary electro-acoustic technology, it integrates written musical tradition, improvisation and an adapted classical repertoire. The Cristal Baschet and the Euphone form the basis of the ensemble's sophisticated instrumental collection. The new works reflect these neglected and little-known instruments. The Ensemble HOPE, consisting of Frederic Bousquet (Euphone), Marc Antoine Millon (Bass Cristal) and Armelle Marq (soprano voice), is also actively engaged in developing a new generation of Euphones. In this concert from 2019's Classical:NEXT!, the ensemble performs Frederic Bousquet's Vénus, Epilogue and en transit, Henry Purcell's Dido’s lament, arranged by M.A. Millon, Georg Friedrich Händel's Lascia ch'io pianga, arranged by M.A. Millon, as well as works by Eric Satie, Roger Steptoe, Bruno Giner, and Marc Antoine Millon.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons And Oslo Philharmonic - In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: In this episode of ‘In Rehearsal,’ Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons guides the Oslo Philharmonic through the powerful Suite from Béla Bartók’s pantomime ballet The Miraculous Mandarin, culminating in a performance at the Oslo Concert Hall.

programme.title: Leslie Grinage, Peter Childs And Odetta Holmes - Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery. This 1964 episode of Face au Public shows the melancholy of the era.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: Omer Avital - Omer Avital Qantar - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. Israeli-American double bassist Omer Avital plays radiantly energetic, resounding jazz with oriental influences. At Jazz in Duketown 2019, Avital forms a quintet with saxophonists Asaf Yuria and Alexander Levin, drummer Ofri Nehemya, and pianist Eden Ladin. They present singular repertoire from Avital's album 'Qantar'.

programme.title: Micah McLaurin - PIAM - Semi-final I: Chopin and Scriabin
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Micah McLaurin (USA, 1994) performs Frédéric Chopin’s Nocturne Op. 27 No. 2, and Barcarolle, Op. 60; and a selection of Alexander Scriabin’s Etudes: Op. 42 No. 5, and Op. 8 Nos. 11 and 12. This performance was recorded at Teatro EDI Barrio’s in Milan, in January 2020.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Betty Carter - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Weser-Renaissance Bremen, Manfred Cordes, Festival Oude Muziek And Utrecht Early Music Festival - Josquin - Missa Ave Maris stella
programme.desc: “Paradise on earth.” Luther’s words reflect the admiration that many generations of music fanatics have felt for Josquin Desprez. More than 500 years later his oeuvre has lost none of its technical mastery, poetry, and power of expression. Weser-Renaissance from Bremen is glad to act as Josquin’s champion with this full-blooded programme based around the Missa Ave maris stella plus a selection of Marian motets.

programme.title: Michelle David - Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah - Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah’s quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Frank Scheffer - Conducting Mahler
programme.desc: This is a beautifully shot documentary highlighting the interpretation of Mahler’s compositions by conductors Bernhard Haitink, Ricardo Chailly, Riccardo Muti, Claudio Abbado and Sir Simon Rattle. Through interviews, these conductors explain their ideas about the work of Mahler. This documentary by Frank Scheffer includes rehearsals and performances by the Amsterdam Concertgebouw, the Berlin Philharmonic and the Vienna Philharmonic during the major Mahler festival which took place in May 1995 at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. This documentary offers important new interpretations of Gustav Mahler’s work by major conductors and orchestras, redefining his position in the modern age.

programme.title: Joe Turner, Kenny Clarke, Don Byas And Art Simmons - Joe Turner - Jazz Marmalade
programme.desc: This vintage program, ‘Jazz Marmalade’, shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. First, American stride pianist Joe Turner (often confused with blues shouter ‘Big’ Joe Turner) opens this atmospheric broadcast with a swinging piano-bass duet recorded at the Mars Club. Joe Turner (1907–1990) would remain in Paris for the rest of his life. From the American-owned Mars Club just off the Champs-Élysées, a hangout for showbiz people and expatriate Americans in Paris, the program cuts to the Blue Note. There, a Paris-based American quartet that includes drummer Kenny Clarke, organ player Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas performs ‘Salut Les Copines’. Returning to the Mars Club, the American jazz trio of house pianist Art Simmons (1926–2018) performs a jaunty take on ‘C-Jam Blues’. Rounding off the program at the Blue Note, the quartet of drummer Kenny Clarke, organist Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas returns for a swinging ‘April in Paris’. These recordings offer an invaluable glimpse into expatriate American jazz-making in Paris in the early 1960s.

programme.title: Jason Lindner, BIGYUKI, Lenny Reece And Randy Runyon - Live at the Office: BIGYUKI And Now vs Now
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and Stingray DJAZZ have been collaborating for a series of music programmes: ‘BIRD.tv’, allowing you to experience the best BIRD concerts and interviews as from the first row! This episode is a fantastic special live recorded in the BIRD office with BIGYUKI and Now Vs. Now.

programme.title: Amilton Godoy - Amilton Godoy - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist Amilton Godoy. He is not only a well-known soloist in his homeland Brazil, but he is also considered one of the world's greatest pianists today, regularly guesting with international top orchestras and conductors. Godoy frequently teaches workshops throughout Brazil and abroad.

programme.title: Al Jarreau, Tom Canning, Peter Robinson And Ralph Humphrey - Al Jarreau - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1981, American singer and Grammy Award winner Al Jarreau gave an unforgettable performance for the audience of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Evgeny Kissin, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra And Antoni Wit - Chopin - Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performance of Frédéric Chopin's Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21. Evgeny Kissin features as the soloist. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Piotr Pawlak - PIAM - Semi-final: Franck, Ravel and Prokofiev
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Piotr Pawlak (Poland, 1998) performs César Franck’s Prelude, Chorale and Fugue in B minor; Maurice Ravel’s Pavane pour une infant défunte; and Sergei Prokofiev’s Sonata No. 4 in C minor, Op. 29. As an encore, Pawlak plays J. S. Bach’s Prelude and Fugue in C major, BWV 846; the final fugue from Leopold Godowsky’s Passacaglia in B minor; and Frédéric Chopin’s Etude in C-sharp minor, Op. 10 No. 4. This performance was recorded at Auditorium Giorgio Gaber in Milan, in November 2019.

programme.title: Aleksandra Klimczak And Antoni Beksiak - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Śniedź
programme.desc: Śniedź is a voice and electronics duo from Warsaw, Poland who combine extended vocal techniques with improvised, self-named “glitchtronica.” Singer, performer, and sound artist Aleksandra Klimczak frequently breaks boundaries between art genres through cooperating with young artists from different artistic fields. Her work has been awarded from scholarships from the Polish Ministry of Culture and the Capital City of Warsaw. Music curator Antoni Beksiak deals with contemporary crossover, ethnic, classical, jazz, and pop music in his work as an initiator, critic and creator. During this showcase recorded at Classical:NEXT 2019 in Rotterdam, The Netherlands the perform a set list of their own works.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne - DJAZZ Portrait: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life.
